title: Phones and narrow windows — everything that would change, in one place

steps.path: The strip across the top of the Android app or a phone browser
steps.headline: Phone top bar: one plain name button in the middle of the screen, with small status lights under it.
steps.changed: Today the name sits in an outlined pill with a "+N" count beside it. Decided: menu and Projects on the left, the terminal switch on the right, and the session name centred with one small light per session underneath.
steps.notice: Tapping anywhere on the name or the lights opens your sessions. The lights fade while the list is open.
steps.risk: The lights stop at 12; with more sessions than that, the rest only show in the list. There is no + New session on the bar: it stays inside the list.

steps.path: Tap the session name at the top
steps.headline: Phone session list: full width, under a "Your sessions" heading, with model names no longer cut off.
steps.changed: The list runs edge to edge instead of floating as a narrower box. Each row shows the model alone ("Sonnet", not "Claude Code · Sonnet"), lines up with the heading, and has no drag handle.
steps.notice: Working / Inactive stay as words, as today. Model names that were cut short today now fit.
steps.risk: Without the drag handle, sessions can't be reordered by dragging on a phone.

steps.surface: Pills and shortcut chips on a phone
steps.path: Above and below the message box, on a phone browser connected to your computer
steps.headline: Pills and shortcut chips: one swipeable row each, all the same 24-pixel height and shape.
steps.changed: Today the pills wrap onto two lines in mixed sizes, and "REMOTE" sits in the top bar. Decided: one row you swipe sideways, a small computer icon with a faint green glow first in the row when you are connected to your computer, and a square edit pencil.
steps.measured: Pills and chips 24 px tall (today: chips 32 px, pills 20 to 24 px)
steps.notice: The bottom of the screen is about one line shorter, so more of the chat shows.
steps.risk: 24 px is below the 32 px finger size used elsewhere on phones, so a tap near a pill's edge may miss. Pills past the right edge are hidden until you swipe.

steps.surface: Top bar in a narrow computer window
steps.path: The YouCoded window on a computer, dragged narrow
steps.headline: Narrow computer window: the session name sits on the left after the menu, readable, with its lights.
steps.changed: Today the name is squeezed to a letter or two between the buttons. Decided: Projects moves into the menu, the name starts right after the menu button, and the Minimize / Maximize / Close buttons keep their place.
steps.notice: The window also stops shrinking at 340 pixels wide, so nothing can overlap.
steps.risk: Projects takes two clicks instead of one in a narrow window. The 340-pixel stop is the one change already in real app code, and it has never been tried in a real window yet.

steps.path: The YouCoded window on a computer, dragged narrow
steps.headline: The full narrow window: the new top bar above, the single row of pills below.
steps.changed: Everything from the earlier pages together, in a computer window instead of a phone.
steps.notice: A Mac follows the same rule with its coloured buttons on the left. That is described only; no picture of a Mac can be made here.
steps.risk: The Mac version will be built without anyone having seen it.

steps.surface: Menu in a narrow computer window
steps.path: Click the three-line menu at the top left
steps.headline: The menu itself keeps the same rows, including Projects.
steps.changed: The menu's rows are the same as today. What differs in the picture is the bar above it.
steps.notice: Projects is reached here in a narrow computer window.

steps.surface: Session list in a wide window
steps.path: Click the session name at the top of a normal-sized window
steps.headline: At every width, each session row shows the model alone, so long names are no longer cut off.
steps.changed: "Claude Code · Sonnet" becomes "Sonnet"; "YouCoded Coder · Qwen2.5 C…" becomes "Qwen2.5 Coder:14b". The small brand mark stays beside it.
steps.notice: This is the only change people on a normal-sized computer window will see. Hold the pointer over the model to read the full text.
steps.risk: Which app runs the model (Claude Code or YouCoded Coder) is now told only by the small mark and the hover text.

steps.path: A phone connected to your computer
steps.headline: Click around the decided phone layout: does anything feel wrong?
steps.hint: Tap the name or lights to open your sessions. Swipe or scroll the pill row under the message box sideways. Tap the three-line menu. Nothing here is saved and no model answers.
steps.changed: The decided top bar, session list, pills and chips, all switched on together.
steps.notice: This is a practice copy of the app with made-up sessions.

steps.path: The YouCoded window on a computer, dragged narrow
steps.headline: Click around the decided narrow computer window: does anything feel wrong?
steps.hint: Click the name to open your sessions, and the three-line menu to find Projects. The window buttons are for show here.
steps.changed: The same layout with the name on the left and Projects inside the menu.
steps.notice: The 340-pixel stop can't be felt here; that needs a real test window, which comes during the build.

steps.headline: Open the session list in a wide window: are the model-only rows right?
steps.hint: Click the session name at the top. Hold the pointer over a model name to see the full text.
steps.changed: Only the model text in each row differs from today.
steps.notice: Everything else in a wide window is as it is today on this branch.
